summary: Iteration 18: End-to-end testing of the new SaaS Dashboard metrics on GET /api/superadmin/dashboard and frontend /admin/dashboard. Backend pytest: 18/18 PASS - validates ARPU (174.75 = MRR/companies), churn_rate (20% = 1 inactive / 5 total), funnel (free=3, basic=0, enterprise=1, upgrades_total=2, downgrades_total=2), engagement (active_7d=0, active_30d=1, total_users=10, with 30d >= 7d), top_companies (sorted desc by score, schema name/plan/patients/sales/consultations/score), module_usage (array {name,count} for Inventario/Ventas/Proveedores/Finanzas), platform_volume (total_sales_volume=Q5300, sales_volume_month=Q0, total_transactions=5, avg_patients_per_company=5.0), 403 for non-superadmin admin, 401/403 unauthenticated. Frontend Playwright: SuperAdmin login lands on /admin/opticas; clicking Dashboard nav opens /admin/dashboard rendering all sections. Verified 5 KPI cards (Q699 MRR / 4 Opticas / 20 Pacientes / Q174.75 ARPU / 20% Churn), 4 engagement mini cards (0 Activos 7d/10, 1 Activos 30d/10, Q0 Ventas del mes, 5 Pac. promedio/optica), Funnel de Conversion card showing Free=3, Basic=0, Enterprise=1 with bars + '2 upgrades' (green) / '2 downgrades' (red), Top 5 Opticas list (Cortexia Demo #1 9pac 5ventas 58cons Free, Visión Clara #2, Altavista #3 Enterprise, TEST_Optica_1775523355 #4 - only 4 rows because there are 4 active companies), Uso de Modulos Opcionales bar chart with 4 colored bars (Inventario/Ventas/Proveedores/Finanzas all =1), Crecimiento de Pacientes 6-month AreaChart, Revenue por Plan bar, Opticas por Plan pie. 4 recharts SVGs rendered.

minor.issue: Performs N+1 queries (3 count_documents per active company for patients/sales/consultations in top_companies loop + 1 per company in companies_at_limit + 1 per company in patients_per_company). With many companies this scales poorly. Recommend a single aggregation pipeline grouped by company_id.
mrr_trend is computed but NOT returned in response (lines 56-66 in routes/superadmin.py). The 6-month MRR trend variable is built then dropped. Either return it or remove the dead code.

Engagement 'active_7d/active_30d' uses string-based ISO comparison on created_at - works only because all data is stored as ISO strings in UTC. If a downstream service writes datetime objects, the >= comparison will silently fail and return 0. Recommend storing as BSON Date.
active_7d variable on line 108 (`db.login_attempts.count_documents({})`) is computed then immediately overwritten by `len(active_users_7d)` on line 247. Dead code.

churn_rate denominator is (active + inactive) but companies count_documents uses `is_active: {$ne: False}` which counts docs without the field as active. This is fine but worth documenting; if a company doc lacks is_active it counts as active, masking incomplete data.

issues: Currently shows only 4 entries (because there are only 4 active companies) - consider showing a 'No more data' or empty-row placeholder for visual consistency when < 5 companies exist.
TEST_Optica_1775523355 (test data) appears in the Top 5 ranking. Not a bug, but the seed leak makes the list noisy. Consider filtering names starting with 'TEST_' OR cleaning the seed.
Basic plan shows count=0 but still renders a tiny blue dot (the bar has min-width). Acceptable, but consider hiding bars where count=0.

action_items: Optional perf: collapse N+1 count_documents loops in /api/superadmin/dashboard into a single $group aggregation per collection grouped by company_id
Optional cleanup: remove dead code (mrr_trend computed but not returned; active_7d initialised from login_attempts then overwritten)
Optional cleanup: hide or filter TEST_ prefixed companies from Top 5 list (or seed clean DB)
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/superadmin.py L56-66: mrr_trend list is built (6 months) but is NOT returned in the response payload. Either expose it (the frontend imports a 'mrr_trend' nowhere, but the feature spec mentions MRR trend) or delete the dead lines. Currently the frontend has no historical MRR chart.
/app/backend/routes/superadmin.py L108: `active_7d = await db.login_attempts.count_documents({})` is dead code - immediately overwritten at L247 by `len(active_users_7d)`. Remove.

/app/backend/routes/superadmin.py L159-171 (top_companies loop) issues 3*N count_documents calls per active company. For 100 companies that's 300 round-trips per dashboard load. Refactor to a single aggregation: `db.patients.aggregate([{$match:{is_deleted:{$ne:true}}},{$group:{_id:'$company_id', n:{$sum:1}}}])` then join in memory.

/app/backend/routes/superadmin.py L97: end-of-month computation `(m_dt + timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m')-01` is fragile; for months with 31 days the next-month boundary skips a day. Use dateutil.relativedelta(months=1) or proper calendar arithmetic.
/app/backend/routes/superadmin.py L176-185 module_usage: nested 3-loop O(plans * companies * modules). Build a plan_id->modules map once then a single pass over companies.

/app/frontend/src/pages/SuperAdminDashboard.js L260-268: Opticas Cerca del Limite shows percentages > 100% as text (e.g. '3/1 suc (300%)' was observed). The bar/alert UI clamps at 100% but the text shows 300%. Either clamp the displayed % at 100% or change the label to 'Excedido'.
